events.event: Danantara published its first consolidated financial statements, for April-December 2025, at a press conference in Jakarta, reporting net profit of Rp203.4 trillion for nine months (Rp259.6 trillion annualized).
events.key_numbers: Net profit Rp203.4 T (Apr-Dec 2025), Rp259.6 T annualized · Revenue Rp2,385.2 T (9 months), Rp3,073 T annualized · Total assets Rp11,607 T (+5.0%) · Equity Rp2,980 T (+5.6%) · ROE 8.7% (annualized) · EBITDA Rp552.5 T (9 months) · Dividends received Rp143 T, ~Rp11 T paid to the state · BPK opinion WTP (per Liputan6)
events.why_it_matters: Danantara controls 1,000+ BUMN and the long-delayed first report finally shows how big and how profitable it is; headlines differ (Rp203 T vs Rp259 T) because of annualization.
events.spreading_evidence: Covered by CNBC Indonesia, Bisnis, Antara, Liputan6, detik, Republika, Metro TV on 25 Nov

events.event: The IHSG closed down 0.84% on 25 November amid rupiah weakness, with foreign investors net selling about Rp336 billion.
events.key_numbers: IHSG 5,197.61 (-43.97 pts, -0.84%) · Intraday low ~5,174 (-1.3%) at 15:15 WIB · Foreign net sell Rp336.22 B (BBRI Rp217.9 B, TLKM ~Rp131-133 B) · Foreign net buy BBCA Rp323 B, BMRI Rp134.6 B · Value Rp7.10 T, volume 20.71 B shares (Kontan) · LQ45 542.86 (-0.60%) · 43.1% below 20 Jan 2026 high of 9,134.70
events.why_it_matters: IHSG is back near 5,200, still about 43% below its January peak, as foreigners keep selling big banks and Telkom.

events.event: The rupiah weakened to about Rp18,332 per US dollar on 25 November, a new weakest level, as dollar strength, Fed hike bets and domestic politics weighed.
events.key_numbers: Rp18,332/USD close, -102 pts (-0.56%) per Disway; Journalarta says Rp18,303 (+0.67% USD/IDR), unclear if close or intraday · Previous record close Rp18,268 (16 Nov, Bisnis/Kontan) · 24 Nov close Rp18,230 · Cited drivers: Fed hike expectations for December, US PCE data due Wed night, MSCI review (decision by 30 Jun 2027), Middle East tensions, VP succession politics
events.why_it_matters: A weaker rupiah raises prices of imports, fuel and electronics, and sets a fresh all-time low following the 18 Nov BI hike.
events.spreading_evidence: Multiple outlets headline 'rupiah tembus' on 25 Nov

events.event: US markets are closed on 26 November for Thanksgiving, leaving thin liquidity as the US October PCE inflation data and December Fed hike bets drive the dollar.
events.key_numbers: US PCE (October) due Wed 25 Nov night WIB-time · Fed December hike expectations cited by BRI Danareksa Sekuritas · MSCI Asia-Pacific ex-Japan -3.2% on 25 Nov (Journalarta; not verified)
events.why_it_matters: A hawkish US Fed is a main reason the rupiah and IHSG keep sliding.
